metadata.question: Were there two isolated islands within a 2 km radius of (27.245974, 140.878144) on March 30, 2014?

data.raw_code: 1. The user wants to determine whether two separate islands exist within 2 km of the point (27.245974, 140.878144) at a given date (2014-03-30). 2. GEE data: - MODIS land-water mask (MCD12Q1) is annual, so it's available by year. But we need a mask with at most 2 km resolution to resolve shoreline at a one-day boundary. - JRC Global Surface Water (GSW) dataset has a water occurrence layer at 30 m, and also a “seasonality” (monthly) layer lower but higher-resolution than MODIS. 3. We’ll combine: (A) JRC monthly water classification (for 2014-03) as the primary source, (B) Landsat-8 SR collection (because for 2014-03 only Landsat-8 is on orbit) to create our own 30 m water mask via NDWI > 0. Whichever non-empty collection we get first, we process; if both collections have 0 images for 2014-03-30 ±15 days we return C1; if after valid-cloud-free pixels remain 0 we return C2; if any image calculation fails NA we return C3. 4. “Island” definition in this task: a distinct connected land body (pixel cluster > 9 pixels ≈ 0.8 ha) completely surrounded by water. We rasterize the 2 km circle, label connected land regions via ee.Algorithms.ConnectedComponents, and count the number of components with a reasonable size. 5. If we find exactly two distinct land blobs we answer A (Yes); otherwise B (No). 6. We print concise evidence: “Collection: X, usable pixels: Y, islands found: Z.” Then we end with A or B as required; or C1/C2/C3 if any of those conditions hit. import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') loc = ee.Geometry.Point(140.878144, 27.245974) roi = loc.buffer(2000) # 2 km # try Landsat-8 first (only one on-orbit in March 2014) l8 = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(loc) .filterDate('2014-03-15','2014-04-15') .sort('CLOUD_COVER') .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(0b11111).eq(0))) .map(lambda img: img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3','SR_B5']).rename('NDWI')) .select('NDWI')) if l8.size().getInfo() == 0: # fall back to JRC monthly layer jrc = (ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory') .filterBounds(loc) .filterDate('2014-03-01','2014-03-31') .select('water') .first()) jrc = jrc.eq(0) # land label jrc = jrc.clip(roi) mask = jrc else: mask = l8.median().lte(0) # NDWI <=0 => land # count valid pixels after masking pix = mask.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo() if pix['NDWI'] if l8.size().getInfo()>0 else pix['water'] == 0: print("Collection size: {}, Valid pixels: 0".format(l8.size().getInfo() if l8.size().getInfo()>0 else 1)) print("C2") exit() # connected components land = mask.selfMask() comps = ee.Image(land).connectedComponents(connectedness=ee.Kernel.plus(1), maxSize=1024) stats = comps.addBands(land).reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count().group(1), geometry=roi, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9).getInfo() groups = stats.get('groups',[]) isolated = sum(1 for g in groups if g.get('count',0)>20) # need > ~20px to be a true island print("Collection size: {}, Valid pixels: {}, Islands: {}".format( l8.size().getInfo() if l8.size().getInfo()>0 else 1, (pix['NDWI'] if l8.size().getInfo()>0 else pix['water']), isolated)) if isolated==2: print("A") else: print("B")

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

loc = ee.Geometry.Point(140.878144, 27.245974)
roi = loc.buffer(2000)  # 2 km

# try Landsat-8 first (only one on-orbit in March 2014)
l8 = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
      .filterBounds(loc)
      .filterDate('2014-03-15','2014-04-15')
      .sort('CLOUD_COVER')
      .map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(0b11111).eq(0)))
      .map(lambda img: img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3','SR_B5']).rename('NDWI'))
      .select('NDWI'))

if l8.size().getInfo() == 0:
    # fall back to JRC monthly layer
    jrc = (ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/MonthlyHistory')
           .filterBounds(loc)
           .filterDate('2014-03-01','2014-03-31')
           .select('water')
           .first())
    jrc = jrc.eq(0)  # land label
    jrc = jrc.clip(roi)
    mask = jrc
else:
    mask = l8.median().lte(0)  # NDWI <=0 => land

# count valid pixels after masking
pix = mask.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=roi,
    scale=30,
    maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()
if pix['NDWI'] if l8.size().getInfo()>0 else pix['water'] == 0:
    print("Collection size: {}, Valid pixels: 0".format(l8.size().getInfo() if l8.size().getInfo()>0 else 1))
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# connected components
land = mask.selfMask()
comps = ee.Image(land).connectedComponents(connectedness=ee.Kernel.plus(1), maxSize=1024)
stats = comps.addBands(land).reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count().group(1),
    geometry=roi,
    scale=30,
    maxPixels=1e9).getInfo()

groups = stats.get('groups',[])
isolated = sum(1 for g in groups if g.get('count',0)>20)  # need > ~20px to be a true island

print("Collection size: {}, Valid pixels: {}, Islands: {}".format(
      l8.size().getInfo() if l8.size().getInfo()>0 else 1,
     (pix['NDWI'] if l8.size().getInfo()>0 else pix['water']),
      isolated))

if isolated==2: print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:           print("<answer>B</answer>")
